finalSentence.text: What's Washington's next move, after SAUDI?

optimized.title: SAUDI BOMBS IRAQ
optimized.fullVoiceover: SAUDI bombs Iraq. The Middle East just split in half. Saudi fighter jets struck Iran-backed militia positions inside Iraq in May 2026. Kuwait launched rocket strikes too. The Gulf is at war — and the US isn't leading it. Riyadh moved without Washington's lead. Mohammed bin Salman ordered it solo. Sunni Arabia and Shia Iran are now fighting through proxies on Iraqi soil — and neither country has publicly acknowledged the strikes. Oil at $140 isn't the ceiling. Saudi production is down. Iraqi oil fields are now contested. India imports 40% of crude from these two countries combined. If Saudi pulls more forces toward Iraq, the Gulf War your parents watched plays out again — but this time the players are smaller, the proxies are everywhere, and the US is sitting it out. What's Washington's next move, after SAUDI?
